subject.title: [Bug]: Tool stdout leaks to chat + reply generation interrupted

question: What boundary should OpenClaw enforce for command/tool stdout visibility in external channels when verbose/full or channel progress delivery is enabled?
rationale: Current source supports the reported visibility path, but deciding whether that path is expected debug behavior, a security leak, or a new narrower suppression rule requires maintainer security and product intent.

options.title: Keep open and split policy
options.body: Keep this issue open for the stdout/channel security decision while routing the final-response retry policy to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/88657.

options.title: Treat verbose-full as expected
options.body: If maintainers decide full verbose output is allowed in trusted external chats, narrow this issue to reports with default-mode leakage or close it after documenting the boundary.

options.title: Suppress internal stdout externally
options.body: Change core/channel progress delivery so internal script stdout never posts to external channels, accepting a compatibility change to verbose-full diagnostics.

recommendation.title: Keep open and split policy
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for the stdout/channel security decision while routing the final-response retry policy to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/88657.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter introduced the verbose feedback surface and merged adjacent incomplete-turn recovery work, making him the strongest routing candidate for the combined visibility and replay-safety policy question.
